notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
wget -m mirrors the entire FTP server recursively, downloading all accessible files to a local directory named after the target IP. Fast and comprehensive but loud — bulk downloads of all content are abnormal behavior detectable in logs.

=== CHAINING ===
Confirm anonymous or authenticated FTP access → wget mirror entire server → grep for sensitive content (passwords, configs, scripts) offline → follow up with targeted investigation.

=== DETECTION ===
High volume of sequential FTP GET requests. vsftpd/ProFTPD logs every file access. Bulk transfer volume anomalous vs baseline. --no-passive flag switches to active mode (server initiates data connection back to client).
